query:
-- Fix Alabama Senate runoff candidates (primary was May 19)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1 = 'Barry Moore', candidate2 = 'Jared Hudson', 
    candidate1_party = 'R', candidate2_party = 'R',
    status = 'Primary Runoff', primary_date = '2026-06-16',
    notes = 'R runoff June 16: Moore vs Hudson. Moore had Trump endorsement.'
WHERE state = 'Alabama' AND candidate1_party = 'R' OR (state = 'Alabama' AND status = 'Primary Runoff' AND candidate1 IS NULL);

-- Check what AL records look like first
SELECT state, candidate1, candidate2, candidate1_party, candidate2_party, status, primary_date 
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state IN ('Alabama', 'Georgia', 'Oklahoma', 'California', 'Louisiana')
ORDER BY state;
